title: CVS Stability Metrics
description: Monitor swimmer count validity, incidents, and algo container exceptions, with validity split into camera availability vs software uptime so camera connectivity and software faults can be told apart

list.name: under_maintenance
list.label: Under Maintenance
list.description: Filters non-operational pools (label on swimmer_count, no join needed). Validity and incident panels also join on cvs_maintenance_mode metric to exclude nightly clean restarts.

panels.description: Percentage of the selected range during which EVERY camera on the pool reported actual_fps > 0.5 (recording rule cvs:cameras_up:bool; any single dead camera counts the whole pool as down, because the synchronizer cannot form frame sets without it). Planned maintenance windows (cvs_maintenance_mode=1) are excluded. Compare with the validity gauge below: when the two match, the invalid time is camera connectivity, not software.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time((cvs:cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m]) * 100)

sort(avg_over_time((cvs:cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m]) * 100)

panels.title: % Camera Availability (per pool, all cameras producing frames, excluding nightly restart)

panels.description: Of the time ALL cameras on the pool were delivering frames, the percentage during which the pipeline produced a valid swimmer count (recording rule cvs:swimmer_valid_cameras_up:bool divided by cvs:cameras_up:bool, both on a 5m grid). This isolates software / host faults (algo container crashes, GPU, stalls) from camera connectivity. Blank or NaN = the cameras were never all up in the selected range, so software uptime is undefined for that pool. Planned maintenance windows are excluded.

result.text: cameras never all up in range

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time((cvs:swimmer_valid_cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m])) / sum(sum_over_time((cvs:cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m])) * 100

sort(sum by (pool_name, site_name, environment) (sum_over_time((cvs:swimmer_valid_cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m])) / sum by (pool_name, site_name, environment) (sum_over_time((cvs:cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m])) * 100)

panels.title: % Software Uptime excluding camera issues (per pool)

panels.description: Daily overall averages, side by side: swimmer-count validity (what the dashboard always showed), camera availability (all cameras producing frames), and software uptime measured only while the cameras were up. The gap between validity and camera availability is camera connectivity; the gap between 100% and software uptime is ours.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time(cvs:swimmer_valid:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[1d]) * 100 and on(pool_name, site_name) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))

avg(avg_over_time((cvs:cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[1d:5m]) * 100)

sum(sum_over_time((cvs:swimmer_valid_cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[1d:5m])) / sum(sum_over_time((cvs:cameras_up:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[1d:5m])) * 100

panels.title: Daily Trend: Validity vs Camera Availability vs Software Uptime (overall avg)

panels.description: Individual cameras whose actual_fps was above 0.5 for less than 99% of the selected range (raw per-camera availability, not maintenance-gated). Use it to find WHICH camera is dragging a pool down in the gauges above.

targets.expr: sort(avg_over_time(((actual_fps{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name"} > bool 0.5) and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m]) * 100) < 99

panels.title: Cameras below 99% availability (per camera)
% Time with Valid Swimmer Count (per pool, excluding nightly restart)
panels.description: Percentage of time each pool had a valid swimmer count over the selected time range. Planned maintenance windows (nightly restart / clean stop, cvs_maintenance_mode=1) are excluded via the cvs:swimmer_valid:bool recording rule. Lower = less stable.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time((cvs:swimmer_valid:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m]) * 100)

sort(avg_over_time((cvs:swimmer_valid:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"} and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m]) * 100)

panels.title: Daily Trend: Validity % (overall avg)
panels.description: Daily overall average of swimmer count validity percentage.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time(cvs:swimmer_valid:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[1d]) * 100 and on(pool_name, site_name) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))

panels.title: Estimated Incidents (per pool)
panels.description: Estimated number of validity state transitions per pool (valid↔invalid) over the selected range, divided by 2. Excludes non-operational pools (under_maintenance) and nightly clean restarts (cvs_maintenance_mode).

targets.expr: avg(ceil(sum_over_time((changes(cvs:swimmer_valid:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[5m]) and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m]) / 2))

sort_desc(ceil(sum_over_time((changes(cvs:swimmer_valid:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[5m]) and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:5m]) / 2))

panels.title: Daily Trend: Avg Incidents per Pool (overall avg)
panels.description: Daily overall average of invalid swimmer count incidents per pool. Excludes non-operational pools (under_maintenance) and nightly clean restarts (cvs_maintenance_mode).

targets.expr: avg(ceil(changes(cvs:swimmer_valid:bool{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[1d]) / 2) and on(pool_name, site_name) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))

panels.title: Avg Exceptions per Pool by Algo Container
panels.description: Average exception count per pool, grouped by algo container. Shows the mean across all matching pools.
